text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the holiday season, and I have the day off. As I take the opportunity to unwind a little amidst the bustling streets…
…Trainer!
Stop right there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm just one cake away from hitting my quota! Please buy one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What do you mean "it's just you"? Don't be so cold! Won't you help out your adorable trainee in her hour of need?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She points towards a showcase in the special sales corner, where a single cake remains on display.
choice_data_list: I guess you won't take no for answer…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Having a trainer like you is the best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, just give me ten minutes! I'm going to get the cake ready.
choice_data_list: Huh? Does buying a cake take that long?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Once this cake is sold, I'll be finished with my shift. So I thought we could go somewhere together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, unless you already had plans? You were wandering around by yourself, so I just assumed…
choice_data_list: Well, I don't have any plans, but…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, it's decided then! I won't keep you waiting too long!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sit tight and wait for Ines Fujin to finish cleaning up after her shift.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ooh, all these cakes look so delicious! ♪ Which one do you wanna try, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I just bought a cake from you, though…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That was that, and this is this! Leftover cake from work and a cake I bought myself taste completely different!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I think I'm gonna go with the one slathered in chocolate! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah! ♪ This is the bag Cassie said she liked!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! I'll take it home with me as a gift when I go back for New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin hums cheerfully as she continues her carefree shopping spree. Something about her seems different than usual…
choice_data_list: What's got you in such a good mood?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ahaha, is it that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Actually, it turns out that my mom has fully recovered! Cassie and Polly have both started pursuing a new interest, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! And that new interest I mentioned… it's racing! They're both taking racing lessons!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It seems just cheering for their big sister from the stands wasn't satisfying enough anymore! Haha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't wipe the smirk off my face during my entire shift. I've been dying to share the news with someone!
choice_data_list: So that's why you invited me?
So that's why you invited me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know I'm usually frugal, but I've loosened those purse strings for a special day like today! Anything you've had your eye on, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I shouldn't be the one getting a gift…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh? You'd prefer to be the gift giver, then? I guess I'll let you have your way.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm going to buy new shoes for my sisters, so would you help me pick some out?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm sure whatever you choose will do wonders for their progress.
choice_data_list: Got it. What features are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well… Cassie has well-built legs, so durable shoes would probably be best for her. And I'd say Polly needs a pair that are lightweight but still practical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I help Ines Fujin pick out holiday presents for her little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I want to check out the cleats section while we're here! Which do you recommend?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay then, let me borrow a smidge more of your time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Ines Fujin leads me to the academy racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Running on the track in my regular clothes is fun, haha!
choice_data_list: You really love running, don't you?
You really love running, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Not just running—I love winning, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I have a hard time believing that I'll ever be happier than I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So that's why I really need to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I got to walk this journey with you. It's because of you that I've been able to keep running as far as I have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Why am I… crying?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: S-sorry. Hmm… this is weird. I totally wasn't planning on any of this mushy stuff…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew… Heh… Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, erm. I…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're my partner.
